title: Apple and Alibaba Are Down, but Only One Really Looks Like a Buying Opportunity
text:
Apple and Alibaba Are Down, but Only One Really Looks Like a Buying Opportunity By 0
Although the indices gapped higher to start the week it is mainly lackluster action under the surface. Breadth is good and there are more new 12-month highs than lows but there isn't much momentum. All of the FAANG names are in the red and there is notable weakness in Apple (AAPL) and Alibaba Group (BABA) . I'm also seeing quite a bit of weakness in biotechnology again, which suggests that there is limited speculative appetite.
